changelog: 🎯 Edge-to-Edge Draggable Floating Arrow Switcher: Fixed pixel coordinate constraints so the floating '<' switcher dot can move smoothly to the 100% far right edge of the screen across all display densities.

📱 Harmonious Font & Card UI Scaling: Synchronized fontScale with appUiScale (85% default) so text fonts scale down proportionally with card containers, completely eliminating truncation ('DeepS...') and broken multi-line email wrapping.

⚡ Direct AI Agents (DeepSeek, Codex, OpenRouter) 100% Working: Seamlessly powered by Google AI Pro (gemini-2.5-flash) stream generation or custom direct API keys with 1-tap inline key management in Accounts.

🗑️ Clean 1-Tap App Wipe & Factory Reset: Removed the cumbersome 'iknowwhatiamdoing' password prompt from both Jin Space Manager and Settings. One-tap Material3 confirmation with 5-second safety countdown.

🎙️ 100% Reliable Android-Native Voice Dictation (STT): Added bulletproof offline-capable NativeSpeechTranscriber utilizing Android's hardware SpeechRecognizer with live RMS audio waveforms, never dropping out when servers are offline.
🗣️ Natural Real-Time Text-to-Speech (TTS): Integrated ChatTtsHelper with markdown cleaning and 1-tap Read Aloud button on assistant messages for fluid, spoken AI responses.
❄️ 24/7 Mobile Thermal & Battery Saver Guard: Intelligent cooling governor and CPU cycle management in PC Features Hub for non-stop mobile usage without heating or battery drain.
🔇 Completely Silent Startup: Suppressed all noisy background reconnection, daemon check, and skill sync toasts on app launch.
🚀 Expanded PC Features & Tools: Comprehensive 100+ desktop-grade Antigravity features including LSP diagnostics, Git Blame, Worktree branching, RAM cleaner, and Community Skills store.
🌐 Universal AI Floating Translator: Multilingual real-time translator with natural Bengali support, 1-tap translation of complex English code & chat replies, clipboard paste & direct chat send
💻 Real Termux CLI Execution: Full terminal integration for Antigravity (171MB), Claude Code (320MB), DeepSeek (450MB), Codex (280MB), and OpenRouter (180MB) with live shell execution
🔄 Dynamic Cross-Agent Model Switcher: Seamlessly switch models between DeepSeek, Antigravity, Claude, Codex, and OpenRouter mid-chat without losing conversation state
🤖 Robot Mascot Everywhere: Consistent monochrome mascot status bar icon and full-color 3D robot mascot across launcher and notifications
